name: Once Campfire
description: Super simple group chat, without a subscription.
composeYaml:
services:
  campfire:
    image: 'ghcr.io/basecamp/once-campfire:${TAG:-main}'
    restart: unless-stopped
    volumes:
      - 'campfire-storage:/rails/storage'
    environment:
      - 'SECRET_KEY_BASE=${CAMPFIRE_SECRET}'
      - 'VAPID_PUBLIC_KEY=${VAPID_PUBLIC_KEY}'
      - 'VAPID_PRIVATE_KEY=${VAPID_PRIVATE_KEY}'
      - 'DISABLE_SSL=${DISABLE_SSL:-true}'
      - 'SSL_DOMAIN=${SSL_DOMAIN:-false}'
      - 'SKIP_TELEMETRY=${SKIP_TELEMETRY:-true}'
      - 'SENTRY_DSN=${SENTRY_DSN}'
    healthcheck:
      test:
        - CMD
        - curl
        - '-f'
        - 'http://localhost/up'
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 5
